scenario: [LSTR.3.2] A codepoint above the Basic Multilingual Plane orders above every BMP codepoint. "😀" is U+1F600; "～" is U+FF5E. By codepoint, and by UTF-8 bytes (F0 against EF), "😀" > "～", so against `i.label > "～"` it fires and "a" does not. A comparison of UTF-16 code units reads "😀" as the surrogate D83D, below FF5E, and logs nothing: this is the vector that separates codepoint order from UTF-16 order.
rules_ds:
schema Item scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    label: String mutable

rule hit:
    Item i where i.label > "～"
->
    log info "{i.label}"
